close_reason: Fixed doc comment: 'omits the field' → 'the notFound field will be JSON null'
description: The doc comment on not_found_json() says 'Returns Value::Null when the slice is empty (omits the field per RFC 8620 §5.1)'. Returning Value::Null does not omit the field — the json\! macro will emit notFound: null, not an absent key. RFC 8620 §5.1 accepts null (that is the correct value), so behavior is correct, but the comment description is misleading. — Change 'omits the field' to 'sets the field to JSON null'.
title: not_found_json doc comment: 'omits the field' is inaccurate
